Notice that the dividend is missing the $x$ term. So, we first rewrite it by including the missing term with a zero coefficient, as follows:

$$
2{x}^{4}-3{x}^{3}+3{x}^{2}+1\,=\,2{x}^{4}-3{x}^{3}+3{x}^{2}+0x+1
$$

Now, using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,2x+1 \\  & {x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}+x-4\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,2{x}^{4}-3{x}^{3}+3{x}^{2}+0x+1\,\,} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{2{x}^{4}-4{x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}-8x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,{x}^{3}+{x}^{2}+8x+1 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,{{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}+x-4}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,3{x}^{2}+7x+5\end{aligned}
$$

As a result, 

- the quotient is $2x+1,$ and

- the remainder is $3{x}^{2}+7x+5.$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2{x}^{4}-3{x}^{3}+3{x}^{2}+1}{\,{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}+x-4\,} & =2x+1+\frac{3{x}^{2}+7x+5}{{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}+x-4}.\end{aligned}
$$
